title: AIAS Portfolio Management Office
purpose: Select dependency-ready macro-deliveries and govern their evidence, benefits and closure.
scope: Portfolio records, scoring, dependencies, sequential stage gates, evidence, master-inventory ingestion and classified benefits realization.

requirements.title: Portfolio policy
requirements.statement: PMO shall define stages, gate evidence, scoring weights and the acceleration target.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Dependency selection
requirements.statement: Only proposed items with completed dependencies shall be selectable.
requirements.rationale: Preserve roadmap order and architectural prerequisites.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Value prioritization
requirements.statement: Candidates shall be scored by strategic value, urgency, reuse, acceleration, compliance, risk and effort.
requirements.rationale: Choose the greatest governed next step.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Evidence gates
requirements.statement: Portfolio stages shall advance sequentially only with target-stage evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Benefits realization
requirements.statement: Time reduction shall be classified and checked against 45 percent.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Reproducible delivery
requirements.statement: PMO shall include tests, documentation, installer, manifest, checksums and release.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

risks: Generated engineering output requires human review.
